notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 regional interaction declaration and no-time Send Interaction With Regions slice in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. It validates owner-created committed region specifications, available-dimension context, independent regional subscription state, strict 2025 region-set overlap, callback-entry rechecks, and the empty-region no-op rules. Object-instance regional registration/association, object-class attribute regional subscriptions, Request Attribute Value Update With Regions, timestamped/retraction behavior, realization/association state, relaxed DDM, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice. The contract uses immutable candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab, including its current source-title path mismatch.
